Travel to Samburu, where matriarch Anastasia turns her elephant herd north after a local river dries up. Then, in Naboisho, see cheetah mom Kuleta evade a crafty pack of hyenas. Later, in Laikipia, check in on wild dog Phoenix and her new litter.

Trail Anastasia as her herd splits to protect two precious elephant calves, while Kuleta retakes territory for her remaining cheetah cubs. Join wild dog Phoenix’s search for a new mate as the skies open up and rain begins to heal the parched land.

Mrs. K is a housewife who lives in a quiet suburban neighborhood with her husband Mr. K and their daughter Lil' K. One day, a Macau ex-cop shows up to blackmail Mrs. K. He knows about her unseemly past. She agrees to his term and they meet. The deal goes sour as she attempts to get rid of him. He escapes and is captured by a stranger. After finding out why Ex-cop is mixed up in this, the stranger kills him. They are after Mrs. K for different reasons. Ex-cop is someone who stumbles upon Mrs. K's identity and decides to try his luck. The stranger, however, bears a grudge against Mrs. K. Things would date back more than ten years ago when a Macau casino was robbed. The robbery was carried out by a band of professionals and was led by none other than Mrs. K...

When her young son Minato starts to behave strangely, his mother feels that there is something wrong. Discovering that a teacher is responsible, she storms into the school demanding to know what's going on. But as the story unfolds through the eyes of mother, teacher and child, the truth gradually emerges.
Georgie's dad, Hung, was a Triad leader. After Hung's death, his right-hand Cheung intends to bring back Georgie to take over. But Cheung finds Sam, whom he mistakes for Georgie...

Makoto Kashiba is angry and depressed after losing his job as an elite banker and being sent to the countryside. By chance (Or is it fate?) he meets a beautiful girl, Kitsuno. However, the man she's in love with is master pianist and goldfish catcher, Noboru Oji. Bonds between them form, and a love triangle begins...

The Paws-Men are Tat Yan, Charlie, Seal, and Keith. When a dog is in need of rescue, the Paws-Men assemble to save the dog immediately like Batman. ”Paws-Men” tells the story of rescuing dogs, in which Paws-Men encounter many difficulties, such as a dog eatery, bullies and a dog abusing granny. Yet Paws-Men witness true friendships between dogs and humans. This film makes us realize: Saving dogs is not hard. People are the real problem.

The year is 2012. The once-glamourous Club EJ suddenly experiences a hostile takeover. Much like the nightclub industry, the glory days are over for the club's manager, Foon, despite having stood tall in East Tsim Sha Tsui for decades. To make things worse for Foon, the club's new CEO is none other than his cutthroat ex-wife, Madame V! Determined to change things up, she leaves Foon and his hostesses with no choice but to transform and modernize in order to breathe new life into their business. Little do they know, a powerful conglomerate has been pulling the strings all along to shut down Club EJ for good. To save their neon empire, Foon and V must join forces and make an epic last stand with the hostesses against what seems to be inevitable doom.

p.d: Hong Kong police agent Cheung works undercover in Kang's drug cartel, while another undercover cop Au successfully earns their trust in an incident, a brotherly-bond is built among the three. After the Police busts the syndicate in Hong Kong, Kang subsequently hide away in the Golden Triangle, by chance he receives a tip-off about the betrayal within his circle of trust...

Taiwanese detective Simon visits Hong Kong and is served by Wing, the young and witty cop. Their adventures begin when they encounter two pretty girls, Pretty eyes and Slant eyes. These two girls are pickpockets and have stolen a jade from the professional killer. The killer is desperate to get back his treasure, that even though the detectives try to protect the sisters, the four are in great danger...

The contract is a piece of almost blank paper by which MTV binds all its employees to eight years of impecunious service. Chi-Man, an aspiring but frustrated artist, hates the contract since he is given no chance of getting ahead. He constantly thinks of moving to greener pastures. His brother Chi-Ying is a self-made investor who has just come up with a laugh bomb. By chance, Chi-Man becomes the host of a Cat TV program. With the aid of the laugh bomb, he becomes an instant success, yet...

A nameless hitwoman who, for reasons not entirely clear, has a lower than average body temperature. She is cold-blooded in other ways as well, assassinating her targets with steely detachment and having only two real acquaintances: the Cambodian woman who gives her killing assignments and money, and the street vendor Long Shek, at whose stand she habitually relaxes after successful hits with a bowl of noodles. Long Shek dubs her Pretty Ghost, and the two gradually become something like friends. Pretty Ghost ends up traveling to South Korea to assassinate a local gangland kingpin, a job she decides will be her last. However, the dead man's bodyguard, Yichin, is out for revenge and comes after Pretty Ghost...

A Dying man is leaving behind him a no good son, a very good daughter, a scheming nephew, a vast fortune and a will which bequeaths everything to the daughter. So the scheming nephew gets Tricky star to steal the will in order to alter it. The son is not idle either. He finds Phoenix, a garbage collector, to pose as the absent daughter who looks the same as Phoenix. Phoenix files into Hong Kong and gets into the house in great pomp. She also surprises a thieving Tricky Star, who immediately assumes the role of a suitor. That pleases Phoenix immensely...

Sam and his team are members of a Serious Crime Unit in the District Crime Squad, conducting a crackdown on an international crime organization trafficking in the human cargo of illegal immigrants. The team successfully dissolves the group and destroys its power in Southeast Asia. They arrest one of the group's leaders, Night. At the court, Night is charged with several offences and is being prosecuted by Sam's fiancee, Ann. Ann tries her best to convict Night for all the crimes he committed. However, the defense lawyer is tough and manipulative and finally, Night is convicted on only one of the charges in human smuggling and sentenced to three years imprisonment. Night is unrepentant and vows to take his revenge and destroy the couple one day. During the lawyer's visit, Night relays this message to his brother, Day, and asks Day to carry out the revenge for him...

David died as a virgin and the Doomsday Book says a virgin ghost has no right for reincarnation until he deflowers a virgin human, so David assumes the human shape and goes after Lisa. Lisa's boyfriend Landal however finds out David is a ghost. He warns Lisa but she won't listen...

Richard Ma is a tightfisted, mean and unpleasant character. He is also a wealthy businessman who has become increasingly bitter and mistrustful due to what he believes are the gold-digging women in his life. Following a series of events one weekend, Richard's financial assets are temporarily frozen, his house is looted by his bitter ex-girlfriend and he has no cash leaving him helpless and broke. It is during this fateful weekend that he meets Choi; a struggling stockbroker who is trying ward off the attentions of an unwanted suitor from her local village. By offering to help to Ah Choi in return for financial gain, a most surprising relationship develops between this unlikely pair.

p.d: Twenty-five years ago, a civilian airliner hijacked by Al-Qaeda crashed into the American mainland. The steel and concrete of industrial civilization collapsed in flames, and a terrorist attack that shocked the world rewrote the course of the 21st century. Twenty-five years later, the Twin Towers of the World Trade Center stand as two pools of water, like two scars branded into the heart of New York. Since the complete withdrawal of US troops from Afghanistan, the traditional 'war on terror' seems to have come to an end. However, the shadow of terrorism has not dissipated; it is now spreading across the global security landscape in a more covert, decentralized, and destructive form.

p.d: 河套香港園區第一期兩組地招標收到6份標書，身兼港深創新及科技園主席的創新科技及工業局常任秘書長蔡傑銘接受《大鳴大放》專訪時，指出投標的公司有做前沿科研及綜合型科企。他透露兩園「四流」：人流﹑資金流﹑數據流﹑生命樣本流，先是數據流及生命樣本流今年年底有些工作完成，人流則待明年流通。河套香港園區第一期兩組地有一個實驗室及一個人才公寓，蔡傑銘指共收到5間公司提交6份標書，他指投標公司技術含金量高，當中有3間公司是做前沿科技包括量子、晶片及人工智能。另兩間投標公司是綜合型企業，有科企和科研部門，所以對園區的實驗室和人才公寓有興趣。蔡傑銘指會以技術方案、帶來就業機會及經濟效益評核標書，招標採用「雙信封制」7：3佔比，7成技術、3成地價，而早前洪水橋中標價10億3千萬是考參價，不過他強調不同地區的地價有少少分別。河套園區對投標公司的定位要求必需是香港創科，符合創科藍圖的六大元素。河套港深兩個園區的跨境四流：人流、資金流、生命様本流及數據流等的流通時間表，蔡傑銘指園區的人氣是很重要，正努力提速完善。他指出連接兩個園區的西橋正興建中，檢測樓已平頂。二、三號樓的兩幢實驗室已建好行人天橋，所以不擔心硬件配套。至於無感通關則需時試驗，深圳園區的千人白名單擬定中，正加速進行。蔡傑銘表示希望今年年底做到數據流通：「現在香港園區已有百多家企業，對數據有一定要求，例如生命樣本的數據、低空經濟的一些數據、自動駕駛的一些數據，我們已有應用場景，確保這些數據能夠流通到香港園區。」他強調數據要留在園區，但科研成果可以流出園區，以達到科研商品化、成品化。至於人流，則隨著連接兩園的橋興建進度，最遲明年年中四個流通有不同程度的實施方案，蔡傑銘說：「初步我可以承諾到數據流和生命樣本流，我相信今年年底我怎樣都有些工作會做到，人流可能是明年。」蔡傑銘表示，河套香港園區與北都大學城的相互關係要做好，一號大樓會預留空間給大學城發展。InnoHK 旗下的8間研發中心，有諾貝爾獎得主加入，有香港的大學與海外大學科研交流，包括劍橋、倫敦、美國及歐洲的知名大學，以及中科院，將科研成果國際化。蔡傑銘透露InnoHK的平台會放在河套香港園區，園區的優惠政策會讓科研發展得更好。

集換式遊戲卡牌的店舖正在迅速增長，卡展總是人山人海，更有被視為「死場」的舊式商場因為卡舖進駐，而變得熱鬧。「爆卡」、「打deck」成為不少大人小孩的消閒活動。集換式遊戲卡牌又名「TCG卡」，即是「Trading Card Game」，不少熱門IP都會推出相關產品。玩家透過購買內容隨機的卡包、與其他玩家交換，可用作遊戲對戰或收藏。今年31歲的遊戲卡店老闆Eric，本身也是資深卡友，初中便因為喜歡的日本動漫《遊戲王》推出卡牌遊戲而入坑。當過廚師，亦在玩具店工作過，兩年前決定開店推廣卡牌遊戲。有別於電子遊戲，Eric認為玩卡牌遊戲可以與志同道合的朋友面對面溝通，增進感情，而卡牌數目過千，可以構思獨有的牌組，極具挑戰性。「有好的交流，還有火花有競爭，真的會腎上腺素上升，感覺挺享受的。」有人用作對戰，亦有人用作投資。九十後收藏家Anthony在2012年買賣紀念鈔賺到第一桶金，之後開店買賣及鑑定收藏品，從錢幣、郵票到漫畫手稿等都有涉獵。他說十多年買舊卡收藏，只是希望回味兒時抽Pokémon卡包，與同學交換卡牌的回憶，但隨著近年討論熱烈，不少稀有卡牌價格翻倍，更比得上置業首期。「今個世代，無論九十後、零零後還是一零後，動畫幾乎入血，對他們而言，動畫情意結是遠超於任何傳統藝術。」TCG卡熱潮，到底是曇花一現的泡沫，還是會帶來更多可能？

Hailey 與 Yoyo 遠赴馬來西亞山打根，探訪熊貓之外另一種珍稀熊科動物——馬來熊。保育中心內所有馬來熊均曾受創，兩位主持為接近牠們，需穿上印有馬來熊標記的服裝模擬同類，逐步建立信任。首集聚焦義工清晨日常：Hailey跟隨風趣敢言的中心創辦人 Dr. Wong巡檢電網，徒步穿越山林逾一小時，汗流浹背仍堅持完成任務；Yoyo則負責食物部，剝逾百條香蕉，並親手餵飼馬來熊補充營養品，驚喜發現牠們其實可以非常溫柔。Yoyo清潔熊舍時更需聞排泄物，學習憑氣味來判斷馬來熊的健康狀況。
